buildCmd: cd dash/app && npx tsc -p tsconfig.design-sync.json && cat renderer/styles/indigo.css renderer/styles/plain.css > .ds-sync-styles.css

dtsPropsFor.ToastHost: /** No props — renders the global toast portal. */
dtsPropsFor.SwitchingBanner: /** No props — reads switching state internally. */
dtsPropsFor.UpdateBanner: /** No props — reads update status internally. */
dtsPropsFor.Hint:
items: { k?: string; label: React.ReactNode }[];
right?: React.ReactNode;
dtsPropsFor.AboutModal:
socials: { label: string; url: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[];
onClose: () => void;
dtsPropsFor.CliErrorText: error: { kind: 'not-found' | 'nonzero' | 'bad-json' | 'timeout' | 'too-large' | 'bad-args'; message: string; cold?: true };
dtsPropsFor.StaleBanner: error: { kind: 'not-found' | 'nonzero' | 'bad-json' | 'timeout' | 'too-large' | 'bad-args'; message: string; cold?: true };
dtsPropsFor.Sankey: flow: { period: { label: string; start: string; end: string }; models: { id: string; label: string; cost: number }[]; projects: { id: string; label: string; cost: number }[]; links: { model: string; project: string; cost: number }[] };
